# Flint Digital

> AI-first digital agency for small businesses in the Kansas City area. We make small businesses impossible to ignore online — on Google and in AI answers. Built for small business, by small business.

Flint Digital designs hand-coded, conversion-first websites and runs SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Google Ads. Everything is tested on our own portfolio of Kansas businesses first. Clients own their code, domain, and content. Plans are month-to-month with no long-term contracts.

## Services
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](https://flintdigital.ai/ai-visibility.html): Get cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews.
- Google Paid Ads: Expert-mode campaigns focused on conversions, not vanity clicks.
- Websites & E-Commerce: Hand-coded, sub-second, conversion-first. Delivered in days. You own everything.

## Pricing
- Website Build: $2,500 one-time (custom design, SEO + AEO foundation, analytics, 30-day support, full ownership).
- Maintain: $249/month (hosting, monitoring, rank tracking, AEO citation monitoring, monthly report).
- Grow: $749/month (everything in Maintain + 2 SEO/AEO articles/month, GBP management, reviews, analytics).
- Dominate: $1,499/month (everything in Grow + Google Ads management, 4 articles/month, reputation management, dedicated strategist).
